JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Cooking Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Cooking Expanded: many new meals, condiments and cooking buildings.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Nice Bill Tab
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Nice Bill Tab: a redesigned bills tab with stat readouts.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: It caches the list of the open bills tab: bills that another mod adds or removes stay invisible until the tab is reopened. It also enlarges the shared bills tab size.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.advice: JB mods ask it to refresh through the framework's Nice Bill Tab adapter; otherwise reopen the tab.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.source: Rimling/ModKnowledge; NiceBillTab.dll 1.6 (Workshop 3520130671); BetterWorkbenchDefaults fix 13.11.2026; DNDM bill tab size

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Nice Inventory Tab
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Nice Inventory Tab: a redesigned gear tab; it brings its own copy of Nice Bill Tab when Nice Bill Tab itself is not active.
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.pitfall: Its bundled Nice Bill Tab has the same bill list cache (see Nice Bill Tab).

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Better Workbench Management - 1.7 Waylith (Unofficial)
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Better Workbench Management: counting by hit points, quality and material, bill copying and pawn restrictions.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Dubs Mint Menus: searchable pickers for bills, operations, plants, research and the architect menu.
